key_insight: β-OPSD generalizes vanilla OPSD by making the KL anchor weight β explicit, revealing an optimal policy that geometrically interpolates between the reference policy and a privileged teacher.
engineering_relevance: This turns brittle self-distillation into a tunable, more stable training recipe that preserves OPSD’s efficiency while improving reasoning performance.
method: Introduce β as a controllable KL-regularization parameter in the policy-optimization view of OPSD.
Derive the closed-form optimal policy as a geometric interpolation between reference and teacher policies.
Approximate the RL optimum efficiently by distilling from mixed token-level logits, with return-to-go credit assignment for sequence-level alignment.
evidence_signal: Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show β-OPSD is more stable than vanilla OPSD and yields better downstream reasoning performance.
watch_item: The method depends on carefully mixing teacher and reference logits and on return-to-go credit assignment, so implementation choices may still affect stability and results.
paper_title: $β$-OPSD: Deriving with Policy Optimization, Training with Self-Distillation
